stem: Which one of the following statements about Sangam literature in ancient South India is correct?

options.label: a
options.text: Sangam poems are devoid of any reference to material culture.

options.label: d
options.text: Sangam literature refers to magical forces as irrational.

embedText:
Ancient History | Post-Mauryan & Sangam Age | UPSC CSE Pre 2022
Question: Which one of the following statements about Sangam literature in ancient South India is correct?
(a) Sangam poems are devoid of any reference to material culture.
(b) The social classification of Varna was known to Sangam poets.
